data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 14,679,000 on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Improvements of GBP 4,992,000 on fire and other damage to property, GBP 5,979,000 on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 4,044,000 on energy were partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 248,000 on reinsurance acceptances.

data.prior_year_events_note: Listed events are those explicitly mentioned in the report as largest losses impacting 2014 and 2015 underwriting years; amounts are not quantified in the reserve movement note.
data.prior_year_events_summary: The report cites improvements on prior years' provisions driven by favorable development across property, marine and energy, whilst noting historically significant losses in 2014 and 2015 (Guam Power, Australian hailstorms, Quilliq Energy, Dynergy, California wildfires, Tianjin Port) but does not quantify individual reserve impacts in the prior year movement note.
data.prior_year_events_additional_comment: Amounts for individual prior events are not provided against the prior year movement note; the movement note gives portfolio-level gross improvements by class.
data.prior_year_events_reference_text: As previously reported, from a catastrophe perspective 2014 was a benign year; it also continued to experience a very low level of attritional losses across all classes and developed ahead of expectation. The largest losses to impact this year remain the Guam Power loss, the Australian hailstorms, and a fire loss to Quilliq Energy in Canada.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall gross release on prior years' reserves of GBP 14.679m in 2016, driven by favourable claims development principally in Property (Fire and other damage), Marine and Energy, partially offset by a small deterioration on reinsurance acceptances. The Movement in prior year's provision note quantifies the gross releases by class but does not attribute specific monetary impacts to individual named historical events.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall improvement of GBP 14,679,000 on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

Improvements of GBP 4,992,000 on fire and other damage to property, GBP 5,979,000 on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 4,044,000 on energy were partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 248,000 on reinsurance acceptances.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, gross) 2015 comparative column. Prior-year development (gross) taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a gross improvement of GBP 14,679k and line-by-line gross class movements. Claims development triangle is present and used as corroboration. No gross per-event amounts provided in movement note - event-level impacts are not quantified. Minor summed-class rounding difference vs total reported (class items sum to -14.768m vs reported -14.679m) - total in note is authoritative.
